plan_steps: Step 1 (PLAN): Establish analysis framework by categorizing all 42 transactions into revenue streams (residential services, commercial contracts, project-based work) and expense categories (labor, materials, equipment, overhead). Define key metrics to evaluate: total monthly revenue, average transaction value, transaction frequency by category, and cash flow patterns across the 28-day period (10-02-2024 to 10-30-2024).

Step 2 (ACT): Extract and organize all transaction data chronologically, calculate subtotals by merchant type and service category, compute daily and weekly revenue trends, identify the largest transactions (like the Greenfield Estate Project at -12,500.0), and determine the ratio of recurring contracts versus one-time projects to assess revenue stability.

Step 3 (OBSERVE): Review the organized data to identify patterns such as: concentration of commercial maintenance contracts (Oakwood HOA, Riverside Apartments), seasonal project clusters (Fall Cleanup batch), high-value project work (Patterson Residence, Greenfield Estate), transaction distribution across weeks, and potential cash flow implications of large project expenses versus recurring monthly revenue.

Step 4 (SUMMARIZE): Compile findings into a comprehensive financial snapshot showing total October outflows, average transaction size, revenue composition (percentage from recurring contracts vs. projects), transaction frequency metrics, largest expense categories, and identification of the company's primary revenue drivers and any potential cash flow constraints or opportunities.

Step 5 (REFLECT): Evaluate the startup's financial health by assessing revenue predictability (recurring contracts provide stability), project dependency risks (large projects like Greenfield Estate create volatility), working capital requirements, growth trajectory, and recommend strategic focus areas such as expanding commercial contracts for steady cash flow, optimizing project scheduling, and monitoring the ratio of fixed to variable revenue streams.
